context: Aoi's café, 8am. Kenji walks in for coffee — same morning, different season from the last time. They both notice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Good morning. Oh, it's been a while.
lines.jp: おはようございます。あ、お久しぶり。

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Morning. It really has. How've you been?
lines.jp: おはよう。本当に。元気だった？

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: I've been well, thanks for asking. The usual hot coffee today?
lines.jp: おかげさまで。今日も、ホット？

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Yes, please. …You know, this place really hasn't changed. It's still lovely.
lines.jp: はい、ぜひ。…前と変わらず、いいお店ですね。

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: That means so much, thank you. …Please do come back.
lines.jp: 本当にありがとう。…また、来てくださいね。

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: I will, definitely. …Thank you. Have a good day.
lines.jp: もちろん。…ありがとう。今日もいい一日に。
